parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $f'(x)=3x^2-6x-9$ (**B1**). Attempt to solve $f'(x)=0$ (**M1**, or use $f''(x)>0$); obtain $(3x-3)(x+1)$, or roots $3,-1$, or $3$ only (**A1**; with or without equality/inequality signs). Least possible $n=3$ (**A1**; must be stated in terms of $n$).
